name: Dokusen Kango
source:
Main character gets hospitalized after an accident. When he wakes up he sees a smile of an ideal nurse over him. He does not know how dangerous his trauma is, but he is ready to act proactively during his hospitalization.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在事故后住进医院。醒来时，他看见理想中的护士正对自己微笑。他还不知道自己的伤势有多危险，却已经准备在住院期间主动采取行动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
